$CBRSB just ripped up 6.75% to 178.61 USDT, swinging between a low of 167.09 and a high of 178.63. Volume's over a million USDT, so the tokenized stock stayed busy while traditional markets were closed.

$NVDAB barely budged, up 0.46% at 235.06 USDT. It hovered right around its high of 235.07 and low of 233.87, with roughly 845k USDT changing hands.

$SPYB crept up 0.14% to 770.84 USDT, trading in a tight 769.12-771.14 band and pulling about 108k USDT in volume. All three keep moving 24/7, so you can catch these moves any hour.

$SAND jumped about twice its usual daily swing, ripping a 32% range while its typical spread sits near 12%. The token closed the day up 20% at $0.07645. That's a lot more movement than we normally see. Nothing else crazy on the board.

$SAND jumped 28% to $0.0765, blasting past its $0.057 low and flashing a $85 M quote volume. $QNT also pushed up, up 16% to $268.96, holding near the top of its $224-$270 range with $73 M traded. Meanwhile $PUMP slipped 9% to $0.0055, hovering close to its $0.0051 trough after a brief peek at $0.0062 and pulling in $47 M. The winners are sprinting ahead while the loser is barely hanging on. Looks like a typical day of a few rockets and one deflator.
